mapping.summary: AI finance assistant for forecasts, collections and answers
claims: Finance Assistant grounded in live ledger, customer/vendor entries, G/L, bank, jobs and open documents
Answers questions on aged receivables/payables, margin, DSO, FX exposure, VAT position
Consolidated cash and intercompany balance reconciliation across companies
Prioritised recommendations on cash risks, late payers, credit limit pressure, duplicate invoices and expiring supplier discounts
Daily state of the business digest
Drafts payment reminders, finance charge memos and statements with emails and PDFs
Drafts vendor payment suggestions, cash forecasts, budgets, close tasks and VAT return preparation
Nothing posted or sent without human approval
Schedules recurring overdue chasers, statement runs, anomaly checks and duplicate-invoice detection
Financial Controller Role Center with KPI cues and anomaly lists
Adds intelligence FactBoxes to job, bank, G/L, item, vendor and customer cards
Optional Power BI integration opening pre-filtered reports
